category_edits.rationale: For all four datasets, blend the baseline BCE loss equally with pairwise softplus loss on the existing sampled pairs and valid-position mask. This may improve candidate ordering while retaining calibration, without changing architecture, inference, sampling, optimizer, or training schedule.

edits.find:
loss = bce_criterion(pos_logits[indices], pos_labels)
            loss = loss + bce_criterion(neg_logits[indices], neg_labels)
edits.replace:
baseline_loss = bce_criterion(pos_logits[indices], pos_labels)
            baseline_loss = baseline_loss + bce_criterion(neg_logits[indices], neg_labels)
            pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(
                neg_logits[indices] - pos_logits[indices]
            ).mean()
            loss = 0.5 * baseline_loss + 0.5 * pairwise_loss

change_summary: Blend baseline BCE and pairwise ranking loss with equal weights across all four category models. Checkpoint formats and predictor behavior remain compatible.
